A changed upstream identity changes the digest of every dependent node and of the bundle.

A bundle never claims that a serialized result recreates an executable study.

Container, version, size and count bounds are checked before any decode allocation.

A node-level failure does not refuse the bundle: the node is reported failed at a named stage and the rest of the bundle keeps its inspected result. Graph defects (blank or repeated node, dangling or repeated edge, self-dependency, cycle) and a digest that differs from its recomputation share the edge_digest_mismatch stage.

Checks that the aligned joint law built on either surface is read on the other with identical values and identities and the same refusal details. It adds no numerics and grants no interval, calibration or causal claim.

deviations: Not the published algorithm. The paper's counterfactual transportability procedure is not transcribed. The module combines (1) the ID* counterfactual graph and district decomposition, (2) a closure of single-world c-factors Q[S] = P(S | do(V minus S)) under the Tian-Pearl marginalization and c-component extraction lemmas with the selection-node transfer rule, (3) the IDC* conditioning reduction, and (4) a consistency complement for two-level variables. Each step is sound under the stated model class; completeness is not claimed and is not inherited from any of the cited results.

Model class. Finite-discrete acyclic semi-Markovian models in which every latent term is read by a bidirected clique of the declared graph, independent across cliques (the induced-diagram class of ID*), and in which a selection target flags a variable whose structural mechanism may differ between a source and the target while the laws of the exogenous terms are shared. A district factor is transported only when no selection target lies in its variables; a selection node that would act through a shared latent law is not modelled. The class is weaker than selection diagrams in which S may flag a latent term, so some effects the S-node d-separation rule transports are not derived here.

Identification is complete for neither ID* from interventional laws nor the transport closure: a conjunction that needs a cross-world factor (a recanting witness, or two readings of one parent inside one district) is derived only through the two-level consistency complement, and an interventional factor is derived only by marginalization to ancestral sets and district extraction of a supplied or declared regime law. Failure to derive is `not_certified` unless a verified witness exists.

Non-transportability is claimed only through a replayable witness: two finite models (response-function mixtures over one bidirected clique with a fixed baseline for every other variable, binary support, populations that differ only by a constant mechanism at selected variables) that give identical laws for every regime of the declared evidence family and different values of the query, re-verified by exact rational enumeration. The witness search is a bounded heuristic over one clique at a time with three baselines; a query that is non-transportable only through a witness outside that family is reported not_certified, never an obstruction.

A conditional query is the ratio of two derived conjunctions. When the IDC* reduction applies the original conditioning mass is a positivity guard that is checked when it is derivable and otherwise recorded as unverified (the value then holds conditional on that mass being positive); an exact zero conditioning mass is a support failure, never an extended value.

Evaluation reads exact finite laws only. A factor is the conditional of a supplied regime law and is undefined where that law gives the conditioning event zero mass or supplies no law at a needed intervention level; an undefined factor is skipped only inside a summand another factor makes exactly zero. Counted or empirical laws are refused: sampled inference is a separate route and no interval or posterior is computed.

Bounds are search bounds, not theorem restrictions: at most 8 observed variables, 4 levels each, 6 worlds, 16 event atoms, 24 network nodes, 4 sources, 4 controllable variables per source and 64 catalog regimes.
scope_limits: not covered by the method review: a review of the obstruction decisions, the non-transportability witnesses, the search bounds and budgets, the replay and verification of stored derivations, the mixed-source search or the artifact layers; the named-fixture decision tests are the existing evidence for those

deviations: No published algorithm is reproduced. The route evaluates the stored identification (counterfactual.transport_general) on finite laws estimated from counts and applies the first-order delta method to the whole functional. The identification theorem is stated for exact laws; its consistency under sampling is an engineering claim that is checked by finite-SCM simulation, not a theorem inherited from the paper.

Uncertainty method chosen: the delta method for multinomial cell proportions, not the nonparametric bootstrap. Reasons: the functional is a rational function of cell proportions of finitely many independent datasets, so its gradient exists away from zero conditioning mass and is computed by a central difference at the stated relative step 1e-5 of each positive cell; the result is deterministic and needs no resampling stream, so it can be measured on a grid of designs at bounded cost and replayed bit for bit by a consumer; failures are explicit (a perturbed evaluation that is undefined withholds the standard error and says so). The bootstrap would need one stream per (population, regime, replicate), would re-evaluate the derivation per replicate, and would have to decide, per replicate, what an empty stratum or a zero-mass conditioning event means; that rule is not needed here because no replicate exists. The cost of the choice is the linearization: near a boundary (cells with few counts, conditioning events with little mass) the first-order variance can be far from the sampling variance, which is exactly what whole-method calibration must measure before any interval is published.

The standard error is labelled uncalibrated_standard_error. No interval, posterior or coverage statement is produced by the public result; the interval route is closed with not_supported and a separate capability record (counterfactual.transport_sampled_interval). A nominal normal interval around the plug-in exists only behind the calibration-internal feature of antecedent-estimate so a harness can measure its whole-method coverage.

Factors that read fewer coordinates than the table that supplies them are evaluated as the mass-weighted average over the unread coordinates under the table's own mass given the factor's parents (the exact route requires agreement and refuses disagreement). When the tables satisfy the declared graph the two routes agree; under sampling the estimator is a pooled conditional. The number of averaged factors and any tolerance repair (a negative consistency complement set to zero, a probability clamped into [0, 1]) are reported with the result and bound by the artifact.

Unseen cells are never zero-filled silently. A refuse rule refuses any table with an unseen non-structural cell. Additive smoothing p = (n + a) / (N + K a) over the K non-structural cells is the posterior mean under a symmetric Dirichlet(a) prior; the resulting law is labelled smoothed and a is recorded. The unseen-mass envelope is the range over a finite family of fillings (each table keeps its observed shares or moves the declared mass onto one unseen cell); because the functional is a ratio of sums of products the extremes over the whole polytope of fillings need not lie in the family, so the envelope is a range over that family, labelled structural, and is not a proven outer bound.

Dependence is declared, never inferred. Tables are independent samples unless declared to share units; shared units are modelled only when the tables are the same observations (one multinomial), because overlapping but different tables have a covariance the counts do not contain. An undeclared or unknown relation is refused (sampling_dependence_unknown) and independent tables with identical observations are refused as double counting (evidence_double_counted). A declaration may be derived from the runtime evidence ledger.

Stratified designs (strata totals fixed by design) use the block-diagonal covariance of fixed-total multinomial strata. Clustered or weighted designs, continuous variables, temporal dependence and selection into the sample are outside the contract.
scope_limits: not covered by the method review: a review of the unseen-mass envelope, stratified (fixed-total) designs, shared-unit datasets, the calibration-internal Wald interval, the pooled averaging of unread coordinates beyond the existing chain case, or the artifact layer

The staged result is required to be bit-identical to the one-shot result; the arithmetic itself (residual abduction, forward replay, sample means) is reviewed under counterfactual.temporal_fixed_population, which also covers the general-horizon route.

The fixed-population cross-world support is treated as met, so it is not listed.

The one transported cell that opens is the static additive linear path-specific contrast, which keeps its own theorem-scoped route and refusals (counterfactual.transported_additive); it does not abduce a target-population unit.

The content digest binds replay to the exact bytes the caller registered. It does not establish that the implementation is pure, deterministic, correct or safe, and the library does not sandbox it; supplying a resolver is the caller's act of trust.

Declared Lipschitz bounds, the analytic gradients and the declared finite-difference policy are caller declarations. Replay verifies that they equal the record, not that they are true; a contraction certificate and a normalized density are therefore declaration-conditional (`lipschitz_basis` is `declared`).
The score of the log-determinant term is a central difference in the fitted parameters; only the Gaussian data term can be analytic, because a foreign callback is differentiated once.

deviations: Built-in mechanism families store dense per-equation weight rows, so the dense disturbance covariance admits at most 4096 variables (solver_model_order_budget). The Jacobian, its factorization and the contraction bounds are sparse and admitted by nonzeros, block order, estimated memory, factor fill, iteration count and wall clock; arbitrary callbacks are not serialized.

Sparse blocks are solved by sparse LU with a minimum-degree order and partial pivoting (ties broken by sparsity). The condition number is a Hager-Higham estimate (exact for blocks up to 32), a lower bound on the true value. The Collatz-Wielandt spectral bound is rigorous for any positive weight vector; diagonal dominance of the root Jacobian proves nonsingularity only at the returned numerical state.
Global contraction is a sufficient row-norm certificate. Damped Newton roots alone remain uncertified; affine bijection uses a separate outward-rounded inverse-residual proof.
Polynomial systems use independently implemented outward-rounded interval/Krawczyk isolation; domain completeness is withheld on unresolved boxes.
Coordinate likelihood fitting is local with specified covariance. Bayesian draws are conditional on specified structure and covariance. No nominal calibration claims.
Continuous-time ODE/OU semantics remain distinct from static equilibrium SCMs.
Joint parameter/factual abduction includes training likelihood, factual structural density, measurement likelihood and normal parameter prior; its diagnostics cover all sampled coordinates.
Typed mechanism, simultaneous-equation and dynamic execution blocks extend the existing model compiler; no scheduling result proves solvability or identification.
Named clamps, mechanism changes/replacements and shocks retain distinct identities; numerical/certificate response failures preserve original draw positions.
BGCM graphical reasoning is theorem-scoped; finite polynomial candidate fitting is not a general latent BGCM estimator.
Generalized ID is observation-only with explicit ioSCM/product-density premises; procedure failure is not non-identifiability.

Nonlinear SDEs are diagonal-noise, bounded-dimension (16 states) models written in the portable mechanism language; a square root is a diffusion wrapper rather than an expression operator. Regularity is certified by interval derivative arithmetic over the declared state box and input envelopes with a 1e-9 outward margin (not directed rounding); a square-root diffusion that reaches zero is certified only as Holder-1/2 and the certificate says strong rates are then not guaranteed.

Reflecting or clamping state bounds change the simulated process at the boundary and are part of the specified model; the Euler quasi-likelihood ignores the reflection and reports the fraction of transitions within three standard deviations of a bound.

Euler-Maruyama and diagonal Milstein run on a declared fixed step with a counter-based generator (SplitMix64 mixing of seed, path, fine step and component, cosine Box-Muller); the half-step refinement reuses the same Brownian path. The reported step-halving difference estimates discretization bias of the declared step and is not a bound; the Richardson mean assumes weak order one. Inputs are read at the left end of each step; actions must lie on the step grid.

The Euler Gaussian transition quasi-likelihood is a pseudo-likelihood: its maximizer is consistent as the observation interval shrinks, and the interval-times-rate product is the only discretization evidence (flagged above 0.1, refused above 0.5 by default); its bias is not estimated and no latent-path or particle-filter likelihood is provided. Partial or noisy observation uses an extended Kalman innovation likelihood of the Euler-discretized model, a linearization that is always labelled model-conditional; standard errors are the inverse observed information of the pseudo-likelihood.

Parameter uncertainty of simulated responses is propagated by asymptotic-normal draws of the fitted parameters through common-random-number ensembles; it excludes Monte Carlo, discretization and model-specification error and is reported apart from them.

Finite and Gaussian functional numerical evaluation lives in antecedent-estimate; IO rechecks graph-source identity and exact theorem-derived executable IR before delegation. Numerical component metadata alone grants no causal authority.

deviations: No cited procedure is reproduced: rules are declarations checked structurally (unknown action, unknown input, duplicate rule, blank reason) and applied by removal. Nothing here inherits a guarantee from the decision-theory literature.

Support statuses are caller-supplied and ordered by a stated severity convention (Supported, WeakOverlap, Extrapolative, OutsideEmpiricalSupport, MissingEvidence); an input with no rule is unchecked, and the order is a convention of this implementation, not a cited theorem.

An uncertainty requirement is met only by a supplied claim of exactly its own kind (none accepts any); the kind is a label supplied by the caller and is not verified against how the claim was produced.

The contract identity is a canonical digest that ignores the order of rules and exclusions; a contract without rules keeps the earlier decision_contract_v1 bytes, so the wrapper adds no wire change for existing contracts.

The Python Contract.evaluate / ScientificQuantity.from_effect bridge reads only an unchanged original retained native static mean ATE as one mean_difference contrast coordinate. Affine expectation can consume that point; it supplies neither absolute outcome means nor a joint law or a utility confidence interval. Original execution, support, diagnostics and original effect uncertainty remain separately inspectable, subject to actual native source/support checks.

Response results may retain explicitly declared program units/population or use the contract's unambiguous declarations. Undeclared dose units mean native_numeric_scale, with no physical-unit inference or conversion.

Expected utility is the weighted mean of a declared utility expression over aligned joint rows of the supplied distribution; a hard constraint excludes an action from the admissible set and never adds a penalty, and an empty admissible set is reported explicitly.

The contract grants no causal identification, interval or calibration claim; supplied distribution sources remain unverified inputs. Decision functionals and structural policies are separately scoped records.

Point-only: classification compares the forward response's published point with the threshold within a declared tolerance; an interval adds only a robustly-feasible flag and never a probability or quantile claim.
The finite-action inverse uses the Dirichlet posterior mean of the law it already reads. No new action. No interval.
A mapped coefficient prior, an external power prior, and a request for an unmeasured band refuse.

Enumeration of a declared finite grid (at most 4096 actions) in declaration order, not a search or optimization: feasibility is relative to the grid and the supplied forward claims, and an action outside the grid is unresolved, not excluded. One found grid point is never a global feasibility claim over a continuous domain, and an artifact claiming one is refused.

The frozen record declared a bounded search under antecedent_core::SearchBudget; the executed query uses a plain evaluation counter (max_evaluations). Exhaustion leaves the remaining candidates Unevaluated and sets a budget flag; it does not use SearchBudget or a cancellation hook, so no SearchBudget guarantee is inherited.

Quantile targets use the engine's left inverse inf{x : F(x) >= p}, so a level that lands exactly on an atom boundary selects that atom; a mean-only source never satisfies a probability or quantile target, and independent marginals refuse a nonlinear utility inversion (engine refusals pass through).

Feasibility fields are kept distinct and none is derived from another; scenario posterior feasibility requires genuine probabilities and unevaluated or unidentified atoms keep their mass and block a scenario claim rather than being renormalized away. No coverage or calibration claim is made.
The artifact stores premises and data under separate digests and replays the status table through the engine; it embeds laws and mean grids and refuses a probability attached to a mean grid.
The inverse reads the Dirichlet posterior mean of the finite law the functional already evaluates. No new functional. No interval.
A mapped coefficient prior, an external power prior, and a request for an unmeasured band refuse.

Computes expectation, population variance, threshold probability, the left-inverse quantile and a fractional-boundary tail mean on the draws of a supplied law. The variance is that of the finite law, not an unbiased sample variance, and the tail mean splits the boundary atom; both conventions are stated in the rustdoc.

An exact finite law has no sampling error. Sampled sources report finite-law point values only; they carry no certified draw-dependence contract and therefore report no Monte Carlo standard error or ranking guarantee.

A Dirichlet posterior on the finite law the decision functional already reads. The published number is the functional of the posterior mean. A wide concentration stays at the finite-law expectation 1.5. No interval.
A mapped coefficient prior, an external power prior, and a request for an unmeasured band refuse.
Verdicts range over supplied or checked structural members only; no completeness over graphs outside the supplied members is claimed.

Mass is never renormalized: the weights of a weighted report are used as declared, unidentified and unevaluated scenarios keep their mass as separate atoms, and a truncated completion enumeration becomes one unevaluated atom carrying the count of unread completions. Invariance and worst-case claims are left unchecked while any scenario is unresolved.

Completion counts are never probabilities: a CPDAG report yields unweighted graph-dependent atoms only, and a Bayes policy over a report with no declared weights, or over completion counts, refuses. Declared weights are used only when the report is a weighted report.

An identified set covers identified scenarios only; unidentified or unevaluated scenarios, a truncated enumeration and a weighted report whose outcome domain is unbounded with unaccounted mass refuse to give an interval, and each interval is plain interval arithmetic over the action's inputs, with no probabilistic reading. Scenario support and every utility input must be bound by the caller; an action input bound to no outcome the scenarios evaluate refuses.

The conversion records the source identity it read (scenario ids, a content digest of each scenario's status, weight and law, and the premises and data digests the caller retained) and a conversion given an expected source refuses when any of them changed. The policy must be the contract's declared one. The conversion does not verify that the source report itself is correct.

Python delegates the conversion, identity and every refusal to the Rust core; the adapters introduce no calibrated, interval-coverage or probability claim. All standard errors and diagnostics, where a downstream report carries them, remain unmeasured.

Supplied uncertainty endpoint propagation requires the same scientific quantity across all actions: separate marginal intervals have no joint coverage contract and refuse. Duplicate interval coordinates also refuse. Estimated identified bounds remain descriptive interval arithmetic over multiple inputs; independent affine-endpoint fixtures verify both readings without collecting coverage.

The surface is evaluated only at its declared grid points. A switch between two grid points reports the bracket and a linear interpolation explicitly labelled as an interpolation (exact only when the tie lies on a grid point); nothing between grid points is evaluated and no continuity is assumed.

An assumption range is a declared input and is never a probability: weights are declared for point surfaces and are never inferred from a range, and a robust verdict over a range is a worst-case or invariance statement, not a probability-weighted one.

A sampling interval is retained beside the decision and never composed with the assumption range: the supported composition list is empty, so a request or a stored claim of composition is refused (composition_not_supported) and the decision is unchanged by the interval. This record grants no coverage claim.

A JointMechanismSensitivityResult is adapted only when its range can be filled exactly into a surface; otherwise the adaptation is refused. The existing result's own scope and guarantees are inherited unchanged and not widened.

Unsupported coordinates inside the evaluated range refuse, a sub-range that avoids them is the only supported way forward, and an unevaluated grid point leaves the decision unresolved. Declaration order does not change identity or decision.

Combines per-structure decisions under a declared policy (invariant best action, worst case, Bayes over caller-supplied structure probabilities, report only). Bayes choice is withheld if any positive probability has unresolved payoffs, including an omitted remainder below total mass one. Zero-probability atoms cannot exclude an action. Quantiles and maximum regrets cannot be aggregated by a probability-weighted mean of per-structure values and are refused for this policy.
Minimax over an identified set reads the contract's utilities as losses and chooses the smallest worst-case expected loss; this is a stated convention, not a cited theorem.

An identified set is a caller-supplied interval per action and is reported as given, never estimated; it has no probability law, so Bayes over it refuses, and no coverage claim is made. Necessarily best uses strict dominance, so touching intervals are not necessarily best.

Labelled at best extrapolative; the default support policy admits only supported coordinates, so a consumer must name the weaker status. No interval is supported from the transport step.

The source model's standard error is retained as an uncalibrated diagnostic and never becomes a decision, interval or feasibility statement. The inverse origin is a declaration; replay re-checks that the embedded numbers match it, not that the producing route re-executes.

Source population, state and action identities, all policy rules, original episode data and assumptions remain in the native compiler recipe. The method requires sequential exchangeability, consistency, complete follow-up, isolation and observed support of every policy history.

A joint delete-subject jackknife retains failures and withholds covariance if any deletion loses support. Its derived normal interval is unsupported and uncalibrated; a distinct coverage experiment is registered without attesting its results.
An independent two-period hand calculation verifies the exact policy means and shared outcome covariance; it does not establish calibrated coverage or scientific authority.

Complete cluster randomization uses the existing multivariate Neyman estimator, retaining separate conservative arm covariance matrices. Fixed pretreatment adjustment is computed from retained cluster totals; only centered adjustment restores arm means to the original scale.

Matched-pair assignment retains full treated and reference covariance over independent randomized pairs. The switchback route reuses the existing sequence sandwich with zero washout and a declared no-carryover premise; joint covariance is obtained by polarization.

The compilation records source values, assignment design, exposure assumptions, intervention identities, and consistency declarations. Numerical execution does not grant a support or calibration to a derived nonlinear decision.

Uses a synthetic categorical graph-label channel whose candidate reliability is a hand-coded saturating heuristic rather than the experiment-specific likelihood p(y | G, design) required by Lindley expected information gain.

The channel is p(y | G) = r * 1[y = feature(G)] + (1 - r) / k: reliability r = 0 is the uninformative point and a lower r is a garbling of a higher one, so the score is zero for a no-op design and non-decreasing in the design amount. (Before the off-category mass was (1 - r) / (k - 1), uninformative at r = 1/k, so small designs could outrank larger ones.)

Options are ordered by the identification gate first and only then by the declared value of a single study, never the reverse: a study that promises more information does not outrank a verified one. A subset of studies has no value of its own because values of studies do not add; it is listed unvalued.

The value of measuring a named confounder is an expected value of sample information under a prior the caller declares over the evaluated grid coordinates of a sensitivity surface. An assumption range is never a probability; a surface with an assumption range, or an unevaluated grid point, is refused and nothing is interpolated between grid points.

The repeated-measurement (panel) alternative owes obligations but has no theorem checker: it is listed as an unscored route, never as an option, and the time invariance it relies on is an assumption no study establishes.
A study that only names a variable, or only adds rows, is never credited with an unlock: the unlock list names the variables of the studies a repair search verified sufficient on their own.

The evidence_plan_v1 artifact embeds the sealed repair_search_receipt_v1 container of every route and the design_ranking_v1 container of the value evaluation and replays both; its digests are content fingerprints, not cryptographic guarantees against a producer that states another contract and re-seals honestly.

The ordering is a point ordering conditional on the declared decision, prior, signals and cost map; its calibration is unmeasured and no rank confidence or realized-study guarantee is claimed. A budget stop is reported as a budget, never as an impossibility.
No causal, interval or calibration claim is made.

Implements the exact-integration EVSI as a point value only. For the finite enumeration and the Gaussian closed form there is no sampling error and no interval; the Gaussian closed form is evaluated with the same expected-maximum-of-affine-functions routine the artifact consumer reuses, so the two are not independent checks of one another (an independent oracle is the stated closed-form constant, EVSI 0.04165773529384315 and EVPI 0.19779655740130607 for prior N(1/2, 1), noise variance 12, n = 4, actions 0 and theta, to 1e-7).

The Monte Carlo route is NOT a supported guarantee. It reports a standard error, replicate count, effective sample size (equal to the replicate count, because replicates are independent), a convergence flag against a caller tolerance and a rank-uncertainty flag from an unpaired z comparison at 1.96, all as diagnostics. Their coverage, the rank guarantee and the convergence rule are unmeasured (calibration coordinate 'unmeasured'); no coverage record is allocated or collected, and an estimate outside 0 <= EVSI <= EVPI beyond its error refuses.

The terminal action set is the same before and after information; a changed action set is a different decision problem and refuses. EVSI is not assumed non-negative or bounded by construction for a Monte Carlo estimate; the bound is checked against the reported error.

Net value is EVSI minus the study cost in utility units and is produced only when a caller supplies a positive linear cost-to-utility map whose utility unit equals the decision's and whose cost unit equals every candidate's; a cost in another unit, or a missing map where net value is required, refuses. The map is declared, not estimated, and utility is not assumed monetary.

Externally computed decision values and external posteriors are attested inputs: they are checked for coherence against the prior (branch values average back to the prior expected utility for every action) but are not verified or replayed. Source overlap is detected only through declared observation identities.

deviations: Nothing in this record is a scientific guarantee about an external model. An external law, posterior or decision-value table is checked only for internal coherence (rows sum to one, the posterior averages back to the prior, the observation and state coordinates and the exact request fingerprint, candidate, prior and sample size match) and is never verified against the world; its trust label is externally_attested or exact_request_verified and is never native_supported. A supplier claiming native trust, or an object that is not a signal declaration, refuses.

The provider is asked for the observation law and update on a finite support only (finite observation values and finite decision-state draws or the two native conjugate families); a request above the declared sample-size or support limit refuses and nothing is approximated.

The request's sample size is authoritative: native signals are wrapped so a candidate design's own sample size cannot override it. Conditional independence of the observations given the state is a declared identity that is carried and fingerprinted, not tested.

ExternalPosterior and ExternalDecisionValues computations happen outside Antecedent: the receipt retains the exact request fingerprint, the provider object identity, the attestor and a digest of the supplied table, but Antecedent cannot replay the external computation.

Three distinct families ship: TransportRepairFamily (catalog-aware classical transport identifier plus derivation verification) and BackdoorRepairFamily (back-door identifier on the one joint observational law a study would deliver, with the returned adjustment set re-verified by d-separation). ZTransportRepairFamily consumes a checked missing-evidence snapshot, independently re-verifies the frozen z-transport derivation and binds its exact factors to hypothetical evidence. A subset is verified_sufficient only when its family's checker identifies the hypothetical evidence, the derivation re-verifies and no unresolved assumption obligation remains.

Z-transport repair accepts only missing-evidence snapshots carrying a checked positive formula; proof obstructions and exhausted or unresolved identification searches are not evidence-repair contracts. Its snapshot is independently portable and repair_search_receipt_v1 exports and independently replays the z-transport family, including exact hypothetical deltas and stopped-search receipts. A sample increase has no classical transport checker and is not_certified.

The search is exhaustive only within the declared bounds (at most 16 candidates, subset size at most 4, 100000 operations) and is never a completeness claim: a stop leaves the remaining subsets unevaluated, a subset larger than the declared depth is not examined and the receipt says so, and exhaustion is reported as a resource outcome, never impossibility. Supersets of a sufficient subset are skipped for ranking only.
A level-restricted experiment is a restricted domain and does not supply an unrestricted symbolic response.

The repair_search_receipt_v1 artifact replays each stored verdict by re-running the family's checker on the stored hypothetical delta; it requires graphs over dense static variables 0..n, and its digests are content fingerprints, not cryptographic guarantees against a producer that fabricates a consistent contract.
No causal, interval or calibration claim is made.

The typed Python ModelDistinction declaration supplies aligned likelihood rows for all declared distinct model ids and preserves heuristic_reliability_scaled_loglik_gap / monte_carlo labels; no posterior model probabilities or Bayes factors are introduced.

Scores heuristic candidate reliability times the mean absolute pairwise log-likelihood gap from one sampled draw; Box-Hill uses posterior model probabilities and predictive mean and variance terms to maximize expected symmetric information divergence.

Count-law arithmetic is an empirical point estimate; finite structural and arithmetic verification do not validate interval calibration, authenticate raw physical observations or grant live provider authority. A receipt binds the artifacts by identity and digest and never by copy. Verification recomputes each receipt from the two retained, sealed artifacts and refuses a candidate present in only one, a changed delta, a swapped signal, a changed cost, lineage, value or decision identity, an identity that does not follow from content, and a bundle that does not cover exactly the ranked candidates. It checks seals; by default each artifact is first consumed (independently replayed). A consumer holding no retained expected identity checks only internal consistency.

The delta and the derivation a receipt retains are hypothetical and are never available evidence: a receipt is always hypothetical, a delivery that is itself not available evidence is refused, and on arrival the repair family's own identification is re-run on the arrived evidence alone. The receipt's recorded derivation is never reused as a verdict. The result is verified, still insufficient or invalidated (a population or regime other than the premises the derivation was verified under).

The bundle identity covers both artifact digests, the decision contract and every receipt in the canonical order of candidate semantic id, so it does not depend on the order proposals were supplied in. An empty bundle, a repeated candidate and receipts read from different artifacts refuse.

The record claims nothing about whether a proposed study will in fact deliver the hypothetical evidence, nor about the EVSI or net value it binds: those values are retained as computed by their own routes and are point-only. No interval, coverage or probability claim is made.

Re-identification supports the backdoor and transport repair families only; an arrival that differs in sample or shape from the proposal, or lacks the joint law the family needs, is refused or reported insufficient with a typed reason. Replay is graded and only the first grade is called native: a native Gaussian-mean (under the normal belief) or binomial (under the finite prior) signal has its law rebuilt from the family parameters and its EVSI, EVPI and net value recomputed (NativeExactRecomputed); an external likelihood or posterior has only the arithmetic recomputed from the retained attested table, never the provider (AttestedLawArithmetic); external decision values are checked for coherence against the prior and combined (AttestedValuesCombined); a Monte Carlo value is bound and bounds-checked but not re-simulated (MonteCarloNotReplayed). External values are retained as attested and never marked native, and a trust or update-mode relabel that the law contradicts refuses even when resealed.

Replay does not protect against a producer that honestly states a different prior or decision table and reseals: the artifact is then the correct ranking of those stated inputs. A consumer binds the contract identity, signal identities, source digests and cost mapping it retained independently through ConsumeExpectation; without a retained expectation a resealed artifact is checked only for internal consistency.

The Gaussian closed-form replay reuses the same expected-maximum-of-affine-functions routine as the evaluator, so the native Gaussian replay is a consistency check on the stored numbers and the stated inputs, not an independent derivation; the independent check is the closed-form constant asserted in the tests.

Calibration is 'unmeasured': Monte Carlo error coverage and the rank guarantee are not measured, an exact-integration EVSI is a point value, and a truncated catalog (bounded by max_candidates) is recorded in the search receipt and changes the identity but is not a SearchBudget search.

Independent consumers retain the validated provenance chain, including parent digests, rather than dropping it after arithmetic checks. Rank ordering uses a precomputed semantic-id lookup instead of repeatedly scanning the candidate table inside the comparator.

Decode is bounded before any work (8 MiB, 1,024 candidates, 65,536 states, 4 Mi table cells); stored bounds above the consumer's own maxima refuse. Corruption and truncation are serialization failures, not refusals.

deviations: Skeleton search is bounded by max_cond_size, which defaults to 3, so higher-order separating sets are not considered by default.

The default applies Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment after the fixed-alpha skeleton search, whereas the cited PC procedure uses fixed-alpha conditional-independence decisions. deviations: The likelihood is a binned multinomial over the declared threshold grid with a symmetric Dirichlet prior, not a model of the unbinned outcome law; the within-bin law is the linear interpolation of the distribution function, so the quantile is a functional of the binned law and inference conditions on the grid.

deviations: Independent native owners for full-program randomization, finite-carryover schedule randomization, full-history finite and continuous longitudinal g-computation, joint endogenous structural-feature 2SLS, joint regime/cohort/time differences in differences, and supported donor-world synthetic rollout effects. A compiler alias never substitutes one estimator for another design.

Randomized means use known whole-program probabilities and fixed preassignment population weights with independent-unit/cluster sandwich covariance. Gaussian common-arm-mean likelihood and proper priors are a distinct statistical model. A separate finite-population Gaussian latent potential-response model retains unequal population weights and uncertainty about unobserved unit-by-arm responses.

Continuous longitudinal g-computation fits all full-history initial, state and outcome conditional Gaussian mechanisms and transformed joint treatment densities. Treatment-affected covariates are integrated under exact schedules, not frozen. Frequentist episode bootstrap refits the complete procedure with failed slots retained; Bayesian inference uses proper Gaussian/inverse-gamma priors and aligned full-mechanism draws. Finite policy covariance must have full joint rank. No release coverage support is inferred.

A separate weaker-assumption local encouragement route reuses the independent-unit Wald and paired Bayesian-bootstrap score owners under explicit exclusion and monotonicity. Its typed output retains the encouragement-specific complier target, weak-stage interval refusal and paired ratio/numerator/denominator draws. It never asserts existence of posterior ratio moments or converts the target to a population average effect.

Longitudinal g-computation retains all treatment-affected covariate histories. Frequentist covariance deletes complete episodes and refits every conditional mechanism. Bayesian inference samples proper Dirichlet conditional tables over explicitly supplied fixed finite supports; every regime shares each complete mechanism draw. Missing history support is refused in both modes.

Joint IV projects every actual endogenous structural feature separately on the full instrument space and requires joint projected-design rank. Actual interaction features are not products of projected doses. Bayesian inference uses a proper joint triangular raw-dose/outcome likelihood with known correlated disturbances, proper priors on all structural and first-stage coefficients, and verified deterministic polynomial features. It does not turn heterogeneous local/complier effects into population effects. Frequentist coefficient covariance is an uncalibrated whole-unit jackknife, not weak-IV robust coverage.

Joint rollout ATTs use supported never/not-yet-treated cohorts at both periods, explicit no anticipation, consistency and parallel-trend premises. The distinct proper Gaussian unit/calendar/saturated cohort-time likelihood models every observed treated cell, with declared known AR1 errors. An omitted treatment effect cannot become an untreated comparison.

Synthetic rollout targets preserve explicitly unaffected donor sets, weights, preperiod fit and the declared persistent counterfactual model. Joint frequentist regions use Bonferroni native conformal inversions at the required marginal levels and an explicit residual-exchangeability premise. Bayesian laws reuse the convergence-gated native simplex/AR1 likelihood with proper priors; distinct treated factors are conditionally independent given shared observed donors, whose data are not multiplied as independent outcome evidence.

Prepared native target execution preserves structural, cohort, history and donor target meanings. Versioned artifacts rerun original data through the actual native owner and compare the retained law. Current consumption independently matches the caller's current full source/design recipe. Historical replay alone grants no caller-current scientific authority.

The ScientificTarget world-source port additionally checks complete source-codebook world semantics, source population, unit, outcome and terminal aggregation. Longitudinal physical arm dictionaries must generate the exact target schedule. This port admits randomized, finite-state and full-history continuous longitudinal world means; other native targets retain their own target kind instead of receiving an invalid world-mean cast.

All current sandwich, jackknife, posterior and conformal implementations remain release-uncalibrated. Implementation-stage known-truth and posterior reference checks do not grant Q08/E14 release supports. The capability inventory includes every promised X07 design and records unfinished implementation obligations explicitly.

DBN-posterior multi-step effects fit this engine per identified atom and retain unidentified mass.

Frequentist uncertainty uses a shared circular moving-block bootstrap of aligned rows. Bayesian uncertainty composes independent per-mechanism posteriors (Gaussian likelihood; under the conjugate backend with an unknown residual variance each mechanism's coefficient marginal is Student-t), with the same coefficient draw reused across time copies. Each mechanism fits its unique complete observed rows once, conditioning on regressors. Independent product-of-sum moments pin the covariance from repeated mechanisms. None/cheap/full validation shares this sequential engine for placebo, nuisance-covariate, subset, block-bootstrap and unobserved-confounder perturbations. Bayesian PPC retains distinct child mechanisms; prior sensitivity refits the composed effect. Single-regression sensitivity formulas do not describe the composed effect. No generic longitudinal efficiency or interval-calibration guarantee is inherited.

A Bayesian Sequence level is tempered like a Sustained contrast: each stationary mechanism carries the long-run tempering along the gradient of the propagated level, and the sample means of the exogenous root nodes the level reads enter as a first-order normal shift whose variance is the long-run variance of their gradient-weighted scores. The Frequentist Level influence carries the same root-mean term, so its block length and kernel-bias factor read the root means.

The target variance is estimated directly from the rows of the replicate batches with no coordinate fixed, so the allocation residual is that estimate minus the sum of contributions and measures estimation error in v(empty) and v(all).

deviations: When every directed treatment-outcome path is selected, the effect is the total effect and is identified by deleting unselected treatment out-edges and running ordinary total-effect ID. When a complementary path exists and the outcome's ancestors carry no bidirected edge, it emits the edge g-formula (Shpitser 2013): P(v | pa(v)) factors with the treatment at the active level on edges that start a selected path and the control level elsewhere, minus the all-control g-formula. With a bidirected edge among the outcome's ancestors it emits the district formula instead: each district of the ancestors contributes its kernel Q[D] identified by general ID, read at the treatment level of the edges entering it.

The recanting-witness criterion is decided exactly on the directed graph: a witness (a node reached from the treatment along a prefix with one continuation to the outcome selected and another not) exists iff some child of the treatment starts both a selected and an unselected directed path, which is what the check tests. With latent confounding the analogue is a recanting district, a district entered by a selected and an unselected treatment edge, which is refused; a district whose kernel has a hedge is refused as the total effect would be.
Directed-path enumeration is bounded by query max_paths and max_len; truncation fails closed rather than deciding the paper's criterion.

deviations: Replicates are draws from the observation model (Gaussian noise at a residual-variance draw, Bernoulli or Poisson draws); a prior check under a residual prior without a finite mean replicates fitted means only and scores the dispersion axis one-sided.

Uses repository-defined two-sided Monte Carlo checks on outcome mean and dispersion with an alpha gate. On a posterior check those two axes are matched by the fit (the normal equations reproduce the mean, the replicate SD matches the residual SD) and have power only against a wrong prior or noise level; a realized-discrepancy axis (Gelman, Meng and Stern 1996) over residual skewness, excess kurtosis, curvature against the fitted mean and a variance trend, combined by an omnibus max-departure Monte Carlo p-value, supplies the power against misspecification.

A posterior-predictive Gaussian replicate draws its residual variance from the conditional given the coefficient draw under a diffuse conjugate prior, sigma^2 = SSR / chi-square(n + p); the residual-variance column is not retained on the posterior, so the prior's finite contributions (inverse-gamma shape and rate, the coefficient prior's quadratic form) are not available to the check and the replicate noise is exact only in the diffuse limit.

A prior-predictive check of a Gaussian outcome draws the coefficients from the conjugate prior the estimator fits with, beta | sigma^2 ~ N(m, sigma^2 V0); under a residual prior without a finite mean there is no sigma^2 to scale by and V0 is used as the variance itself, and non-Gaussian families use the independent Gaussian prior with the stated variance.

A replicate summary within 1e-12 of the largest summary of the observed value is a tie and counts in both Monte Carlo tails, so a discrete outcome's SD (a function of its number of ones) does not lose ties to rounding.
Posterior predictive draws are spread evenly over the stored draws (chain-concatenated MCMC draws are not truncated to the start of the first chain).

Prior sensitivity is a finite grid of isotropic prior scales, variance multipliers around a resolved prior, or external-prior alpha multipliers, judged by a maximum relative effect-mean range; it is not specified by the predictive-check papers.

Simulation-based calibration draws the residual variance and coefficients from the prior the estimator fits with (coefficients conditional on the variance, the conjugate convention), requires n_draws + 1 to be a multiple of the 10 rank bins, at least 50 replicates and independent posterior draws, and refuses a residual prior without a finite mean; it and the MCMC diagnostics gate (the library's own publication predicate with named failing clauses) require separate provenance and are not established by the listed predictive-check citations.
